title: Did Episode 9 drop? What really happened | Conformity Gate Part 6

shots.vo: January 7th arrived. Fans refreshed Netflix. Watched the clock. And... nothing.
shots.prompt: A teenager's 1980s-style bedroom at night seen from the doorway, a TV showing a looping loading circle, a digital alarm clock rolling past midnight, nobody in frame

shots.vo: No Episode 9. Matt Duffer had already said there was no secret episode. The theory was wrong.
shots.prompt: Time-lapse of an empty 1980s bedroom as blue night turns to grey dawn through window blinds, the TV still glowing, still and quiet

shots.vo: But why did so many believe it? Because Hawkins has always been a town where the truth was hidden. Next... the mystery behind Hawkins.
shots.prompt: Aerial drone shot gliding over a dark foggy pine forest at night toward an abandoned concrete research facility behind a rusted chain-link fence, one light flickering inside

caption: January 7 came and went: no secret Stranger Things episode. But the theory said something real about Hawkins. Follow for the next part.
